body: [opus 5.5] Owner addendum 2026-10-28 14:54 ET: 'If that will cause trouble, I'm also okay with just adding a flag to the existing tail command.' A flag (e.g. tail --follow --input) is acceptable instead of a rename; pick the cleaner.

author: devbig030
body: [opus 5.5] Owner 2026-10-28 15:12 ET: keep it basic: typed Enter sends one line, but enable bracketed paste so a multi-line PASTE arrives as one message (the terminal wraps it in ESC[200~...ESC[201~) and Enter sends it; fall back to one line per message when bracketed paste is unavailable.
